name: Ampere
author: Maarten Tolhuijs
description: Amp in your bar: a live current of the threads Amp is working on, your plan's allowance on pace, every recent thread with its actions, search, and one box that starts new work in a terminal, in the background or in an orb.

barWidget.description: Amp threads, usage and actions. Glows while Amp works and notifies you when a turn finishes.

schema.label: Notify when a thread finishes a turn
schema.description: A desktop notification with an Open action whenever a thread that was working goes quiet.

schema.label: Show plan usage
schema.description: Agent usage and orb hours, with a marker for an even spend through the period.

schema.label: Open threads in
schema.description: A web app window needs a Chromium-based default browser.

schema.label: Amp CLI path
schema.description: Leave empty to find it in ~/.local/bin, ~/.amp/bin or mise.
